metas.name: Unabomber
metas.description: A Harvard student becomes the Unabomber after psychological experiments. Years later, an FBI agent's pursuit reveals how his past shaped his deadly campaign that killed 3 and injured 23 from 1978-1995.

metas.name: The Whisper Man
metas.description: A grieving father and his young son relocate to the quiet town of Featherbank, which was terrorized by a serial killer known as The Whisper Man 15 years earlier, while rumors circulated that Whisper Man worked with an accomplice.

metas.name: In the Grey
metas.description: A covert team of elite operatives are living in the shadows. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, they're sent to steal it back--an impossible heist that erupts into a deadly game of strategy, deception and surv...

metas.name: Tuner
metas.description: A talented piano tuner who suffers from hyperacusis discovers an unexpected aptitude for cracking safes, turning his life upside down.

metas.name: One Battle After Another
metas.description: When their enemy resurfaces after 16 years, a group of ex-revolutionaries reunite to rescue the daughter of one of their own.

metas.name: The Gentlemen
metas.description: An American expat tries to sell off his highly profitable marijuana empire in London, triggering plots, schemes, bribery and blackmail in an attempt to steal his domain out from under him.

metas.name: Promising Young Woman
metas.description: An unexpected encounter gives a wickedly smart and cunning woman a chance to right the wrongs from her past.

metas.name: The Silence of the Lambs
metas.description: A young FBI cadet is aided by a manipulative cannibal killer in her pursuit of a madman who skins his victims.

metas.name: The Godfather
metas.description: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant son.

metas.name: The Dark Knight
metas.description: When a menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman, James Gordon and Harvey Dent must work together to put an end to the madness.

metas.name: The Departed
metas.description: An undercover cop and a mole in the police attempt to identify each other while infiltrating an Irish gang in South Boston.

metas.name: Seven
metas.description: Two detectives try to track down a serial killer who chooses his victims based on the Seven Deadly Sins.

metas.name: Bugonia
metas.description: Two conspiracy-obsessed young men kidnap the high-powered CEO of a major company, convinced that she is an alien intent on destroying planet Earth.

metas.name: Wake Up Dead Man
metas.description: Detective Benoit Blanc teams up with an earnest young priest to investigate a perfectly impossible crime at a small-town church with a dark history.

metas.name: Fight Club
metas.description: An insomniac office worker and a devil-may-care soap maker form an underground fight club that evolves into much more.

metas.name: Pulp Fiction
metas.description: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

metas.name: Monster
metas.description: Based on the life of Aileen Wuornos, a Daytona Beach prostitute who became a serial killer.

metas.name: Prisoners
metas.description: A desperate father takes the law into his own hands after police fail to find two kidnapped girls.

metas.name: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
metas.description: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

metas.name: The Batman
metas.description: When a sadistic serial killer begins murdering key political figures in Gotham, the Batman is forced to investigate the city's hidden corruption and question his family's involvement.

metas.name: Crime 101
metas.description: A meticulous jewel thief risks his flawless record against an equally obsessive detective and a volatile rival, while an underestimated insurance broker turns accomplice after decades of professional disrespect.

metas.name: 12 Angry Men
metas.description: The jury in a New York City murder trial is frustrated by a single member whose skeptical caution forces them to more carefully consider the evidence before jumping to a hasty verdict.

metas.name: Normal
metas.description: Centers on a temporary small-town sheriff who uncovers dark mysteries after a local bank robbery.

metas.name: Fuze
metas.description: An unexploded WWII bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation against a ticking clock.

metas.name: Now You See Me
metas.description: An FBI agent and an Interpol detective track a team of illusionists who pull off bank heists during their performances, and reward their audiences with the money.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description: Violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon the aftermath of a drug deal gone wrong and over two million dollars in cash near the Rio Grande.

metas.name: Zodiac
metas.description: Between 1968 and 1983, a San Francisco cartoonist becomes an amateur detective obsessed with tracking down the Zodiac Killer, an unidentified individual who terrorizes Northern California with a killing spree.

metas.name: GoodFellas
metas.description: The story of Henry Hill and his life in the mafia, covering his relationship with his wife Karen and his mob partners Jimmy Conway and Tommy DeVito.

metas.name: Thunderbolts*
metas.description: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, an unconventional team of antiheroes must go on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.

metas.name: The Rip
metas.description: A group of Miami cops discovers a stash of millions in cash, leading to distrust as outsiders learn about the huge seizure, making them question who to rely on.

metas.name: The Green Mile
metas.description: A death row guard learns that a gentle giant in his charge possesses a mysterious gift.

metas.name: Heat
metas.description: A group of high-end professional thieves start to feel the heat from the LAPD when they unknowingly leave a verbal clue at their latest heist.

metas.name: The Furious
metas.description: A father fights fiercely against ruthless kidnappers to save his abducted daughter.

metas.name: The Dark Knight Rises
metas.description: Bane, an imposing terrorist, attacks Gotham City and disrupts its eight-year-long period of peace. This forces Bruce Wayne to come out of hiding and don the cape and cowl of Batman again.

metas.name: The Wolf of Wall Street
metas.description: Based on the true story of Jordan Belfort, from his rise to a wealthy stock-broker living the high life to his fall involving crime, corruption and the federal government.

metas.name: City of God
metas.description: In the slums of Rio, two kids' paths diverge as one struggles to become a photographer and the other a kingpin.

metas.name: Sicario
metas.description: An FBI agent joins a covert DoD task force targeting a Mexican cartel. Operating outside legal boundaries with a CIA handler and a mysterious fixer, she discovers the mission's true purpose goes far beyond what she was told.

metas.name: Snatch
metas.description: Unscrupulous boxing promoters, violent bookmakers, a Russian gangster, incompetent amateur robbers and supposedly Jewish jewelers fight to track down a priceless stolen diamond.

metas.name: Léon: The Professional
metas.description: When her family is murdered by a group of corrupt officers led by the tyrannical Norman Stansfield, a young 12-year-old girl enlists the help of an Italian-American hitman to seek revenge.

metas.name: Primal Fear
metas.description: A high-profile murder intrigues a publicity hungry lawyer.

metas.name: No Other Choice
metas.description: After being fired, a man devises a unique plan to secure a new job: eliminate his competition.

metas.name: The Town
metas.description: A proficient group of thieves rob a bank and hold the manager hostage. Things begin to get complicated when one of the crew members falls in love with her.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: A thief and his team of associates plan a sophisticated heist to rob three Las Vegas casinos at the same time.

metas.name: We're the Millers
metas.description: A veteran pot dealer creates a fake family as part of his plan to move a huge shipment of weed into the U.S. from Mexico.

metas.name: American Psycho
metas.description: A wealthy New York City investment banking executive, Patrick Bateman, hides his alternate psychopathic ego from his co-workers and friends as he delves deeper into his violent, hedonistic fantasies.

metas.name: The Shadow's Edge
metas.description: Macau Police brings the tracking expert police officer out of retirement to help catch a dangerous group of professional thieves.

metas.name: Mystic River
metas.description: The tragic murder of a 19-year-old girl reunites three childhood friends still living in Boston--the victim's gangster father, a detective, and the disturbed man they both suspect of killing her.

metas.name: White Chicks
metas.description: Two disgraced FBI agents go way undercover in an effort to protect hotel heiresses the Wilson sisters from a kidnapping plot.

metas.name: A Clockwork Orange
metas.description: Alex DeLarge and his droogs barbarize a decaying near-future.

metas.name: Scarface
metas.description: In the 1980s, a determined criminal-minded Cuban immigrant becomes the biggest drug smuggler in Miami, and is eventually undone by his own drug addiction.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: When renowned crime novelist Harlan Thrombey is found dead at his estate just after his 85th birthday, the inquisitive and debonair Detective Benoit Blanc is mysteriously enlisted to investigate.

metas.name: The Judge
metas.description: Big-city lawyer Hank Palmer returns to his childhood home where his father, the town's judge, is suspected of murder. Hank sets out to discover the truth; along the way he reconnects with his estranged family.

metas.name: True Romance
metas.description: In Detroit, a pop-culture enthusiast steals cocaine from his new wife's pimp and tries to sell it in Hollywood, prompting the mobsters who own the drugs to pursue the couple.

metas.name: Heel
metas.description: A 19-year-old criminal, Tommy, is kidnapped and forced into a rehabilitation process by a dysfunctional couple, Chris and Kathryn, who try to make him a "good boy." Tommy must find a way to escape.

metas.name: Batman Begins
metas.description: After witnessing his parents' death, billionaire Bruce Wayne learns the art of fighting to confront injustice. When he returns to Gotham as Batman, he must stop a secret society that intends to destroy the city.

metas.name: Taxi Driver
metas.description: A mentally unstable veteran works as a nighttime taxi driver in New York City, where the perceived decadence and sleaze fuels his urge for violent action.

metas.name: Nightcrawler
metas.description: A petty thief desperate for work muscles into the world of crime journalism and becomes the star of his own story as he blurs the line between observer and participant.

metas.name: The Little Things
metas.description: A deputy sheriff and a sergeant search for a serial killer who's terrorizing Los Angeles.

metas.name: Risky Business
metas.description: A Chicago teenager is looking for fun at home while his parents are away, but the situation quickly gets out of hand.

metas.name: The Outsiders
metas.description: In Tulsa, Oklahoma in 1964, the rivalry between two gangs, the poor Greasers and the rich Socs, heats up when one gang member accidentally kills a member of the other.

metas.name: Catch Me If You Can
metas.description: A runaway teenager lives an exciting life by forging checks and impersonating several professions, but his fraudulent activities soon attract the attention of the FBI.

metas.name: 21 Jump Street
metas.description: A pair of underachieving cops are sent back to a local high school to blend in and bring down a synthetic drug ring.

metas.name: From Dusk Till Dawn
metas.description: Two criminals and their hostages unknowingly seek temporary refuge in a truck stop populated by vampires, with chaotic results.

metas.name: The Naked Gun
metas.description: Following in his father's footsteps, a detective works to solve a murder case and save his police department from closure.

metas.name: Roofman
metas.description: A charismatic criminal, while on the run from the police, hides in a hidden space of a toy store. There, he adopts a new identity and becomes involved with an employee, beginning a relationship as unlikely as it is risky.

metas.name: Wind River
metas.description: A wildlife officer helps a rookie FBI agent investigate the murder of a young woman on an American Indian reservation in Wyoming.

metas.name: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
metas.description: Journalist Mikael Blomkvist is aided in his search for a woman who has been missing for 40 years by hacker Lisbeth Salander.

metas.name: Memories of Murder
metas.description: In a small Korean province in 1986, two detectives struggle with the case of multiple young women being found raped and murdered by an unknown culprit.

metas.name: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
metas.description: After waking from a four-year coma, a former assassin wreaks vengeance on the team of assassins who betrayed her.

metas.name: Facing El Chapo
metas.description: Follows two cops who in a routine stop pull over a stolen car only to come face to face with one of the most dangerous criminals in the world.

metas.name: Ocean's Eight
metas.description: Debbie Ocean gathers an all-female crew to attempt an impossible heist at New York City's annual Met Gala.

metas.name: Clue
metas.description: Six guests are anonymously invited to a strange mansion for dinner, but after their host is killed, they must cooperate with the staff to identify the murderer as the bodies pile up.

metas.name: Joker
metas.description: Arthur Fleck, a party clown and a failed stand-up comedian, leads an impoverished life with his ailing mother. However, when society shuns him and brands him as a freak, he decides to embrace the life of chaos in Gotham City.

metas.name: Nobody
metas.description: A docile family man slowly reveals his true character after his house gets burgled by two petty thieves, which, coincidentally, leads him into a bloody war with a Russian crime boss.

metas.name: Killers of the Flower Moon
metas.description: When oil is discovered in 1920s Oklahoma under Osage Nation land, the Osage people are murdered one by one - until the FBI steps in to unravel the mystery.

metas.name: Spotlight
metas.description: The true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered the massive scandal of child molestation and cover-up within the local Catholic Archdiocese, shaking the entire Catholic Church to its core.

metas.name: A Time to Kill
metas.description: A young Mississippi lawyer defends a black man who killed the two white men that raped his preteen daughter.

metas.name: John Wick
metas.description: John Wick is a former hitman grieving the loss of his true love. When his home is broken into, robbed, and his dog killed, he is forced to return to action to exact revenge.

metas.name: War Dogs
metas.description: Loosely based on the true story of two young men, David Packouz and Efraim Diveroli, who won a three hundred million dollar contract from the Pentagon to arm America's allies in Afghanistan.

metas.name: The Equalizer
metas.description: A man who believes he has put his mysterious past behind him cannot stand idly by when he meets a young girl under the control of ultra-violent Russian gangsters.

metas.name: Serpico
metas.description: An honest New York cop named Frank Serpico blows the whistle on rampant corruption in the force only to have his comrades turn against him.

metas.name: American Made
metas.description: The story of Barry Seal, an American pilot who became a drug-runner for the CIA in the 1980s in a clandestine operation that would be exposed as the Iran-Contra Affair.

metas.name: Casino
metas.description: In Las Vegas, two best friends--a casino executive and a Mafia enforcer--compete for a gambling empire and a fast-living, fast-loving socialite.

metas.name: Sleepers
metas.description: A reporter and a District Attorney help childhood friends who killed a sadistic guard.

metas.name: Reservoir Dogs
metas.description: When a simple jewelry heist goes horribly wrong, the surviving criminals begin to suspect that one of them is a police informant.

metas.name: Anatomy of a Fall
metas.description: A woman is suspected of murder after her husband's death; their half-blind son faces a moral dilemma as the main witness.

metas.name: Rebel Ridge
metas.description: A former Marine grapples his way through a web of small-town corruption when an attempt to post bail for his cousin escalates into a violent standoff with the local police chief.

metas.name: Once Upon a Time in America
metas.description: A former Prohibition-era Jewish gangster returns to the Lower East Side of Manhattan 35 years later, where he must once again confront the ghosts and regrets of his old life.

metas.name: Baby Driver
metas.description: Coerced into working for a crime boss, a young getaway driver must face the music when a doomed heist threatens his life, love, and freedom.

metas.name: American Gangster
metas.description: An outcast New York City cop is charged with bringing down Harlem drug lord Frank Lucas.

metas.name: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels
metas.description: When four small-time criminals lose a rigged poker game against a London kingpin, he gives them one week to settle their enormous debt.

metas.name: The Fast and the Furious
metas.description: Los Angeles police officer Brian O'Conner must decide where his loyalty really lies when he becomes enamored with the street racing world he has been sent undercover to end it.

metas.name: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair
metas.description: A female assassin seeks revenge on her former lover and squad members, all of whom left her for dead.

metas.name: The Invisible Guest
metas.description: A young businessman wakes up in a hotel room locked from the inside with the dead body of his lover next to him. He hires a prestigious lawyer, and over one night they work together to clarify what happened in a frenetic race agai...

metas.name: The Nice Guys
metas.description: In 1970s Los Angeles, a mismatched pair of private eyes investigate a missing girl and the mysterious death of a porn star.

metas.name: Inferno
metas.description: When Robert Langdon wakes up in an Italian hospital with amnesia, he teams up with Dr. Sienna Brooks, and together they must race across Europe against the clock to foil a deadly global plot.

metas.name: The Thursday Murder Club
metas.description: Four irrepressible retirees spend their time solving cold case murders for fun, but their casual sleuthing takes a thrilling turn when they find themselves with a real whodunit on their hands.

metas.name: The Irishman
metas.description: An illustration of Frank Sheeran's life, from W.W.II veteran to hit-man for the Bufalino crime family and his alleged assassination of his close friend Jimmy Hoffa.

metas.name: Training Day
metas.description: A rookie cop spends his first day as a Los Angeles narcotics officer with a rogue detective who isn't what he appears to be.

metas.name: Longlegs
metas.description: In pursuit of a serial killer, an FBI agent uncovers a series of occult clues that she must solve to end his terrifying killing spree.
